summary: RETEST #2 of Log-a-Fault multi-upload. All FOUR Radix outside-event guards are present (onInteractOutside + onPointerDownOutside + onFocusOutside + onEscapeKeyDown all preventDefault, FaultDialogs.js L57-60). Bug STILL reproduces deterministically. PATH A: 1st set_input_files keeps dialog open & 1 chip rendered; 2nd set_input_files on the SAME hidden input UNMOUNTS the dialog (count 1→0, chips 1→0, lands back on Faults list). PATH B (click dropzone label THEN set_input_files): the LABEL CLICK ALONE closes the dialog — even before the first file is set. Conclusion: the close path is NOT any of the *Outside / Escape Radix props. Adding onEscapeKeyDown was therefore a no-op. The trigger is somewhere else — likely the label-wrap (LL pointer→input.click bubble) and a focus-loss path that Radix handles internally bypassing the public preventDefault props (e.g. DismissableLayer focus-loss-on-pointer-outside-window when the native file chooser briefly steals focus).

ui_bugs.issue: PATH A — 2nd upload via set_input_files on data-testid='issue-media-input' unmounts the dialog (1→0). PATH B — clicking the <label> wrapping the hidden file input closes the dialog even on the FIRST attempt. All 4 Radix preventDefault guards are wired and verified in the live code; this is NOT the close path. The fix is INSUFFICIENT.

tests_executed.details: Login OK → Faults tab → 'Log New Fault' → issue-dialog mounted (count=1, chips=0). set_input_files(photo_1.png) → dialog=1, chips=1 ✅. set_input_files(photo_2.png) on same hidden input → dialog=0, chips=0 ❌. Upload #3 + chip remove unreachable.

Reopened dialog (count=1). Clicked the <label> wrapping the file input (FaultDialogs.js L371). The label click resolved & scrolled into view; immediately set_input_files(photo_1.png) → dialog=0 ❌ (closed BEFORE the 2nd upload). set_input_files then timed out because the input element was unmounted. The dropzone label-click alone is enough to close the dialog.

action_items: HIGH — onEscapeKeyDown preventDefault did NOT fix the bug. The 4 Radix outside-event hooks are NOT the close path. Stop adding more *Outside props.

Instrument first: replace `onOpenChange={(open) => { if (!open) onResetDialog(); }}` with `onOpenChange={(open) => { if (!open) { console.log('[issue-dialog] CLOSE', new Error().stack); onResetDialog(); } }}` and re-test. The stack trace will pinpoint whether it's Radix DismissableLayer, useBackGestureClose popstate, or a parent React setState.

Hypothesis 1 (most likely now that PATH B also fails on 1st click): The hidden <input type='file'> is wrapped inside a <label> (L371-379). Native label semantics fire a synthetic click on the input. Combined with Radix DismissableLayer's pointerdown→focus race, this is the close path. FIX: detach the input from the label — render <input ref={fileInputRef} type='file' className='hidden' .../> as a SIBLING of the dropzone div, and use `onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}` on the dropzone div instead of relying on label-wrap.

Hypothesis 2: useBackGestureClose (FaultDialogs.js L48) is the culprit. The hook pushes a history entry; some PWA install/CSP shim may be firing a popstate during the upload. PROOF: temporarily comment out the `useBackGestureClose(showIssueDialog, closeIssueDialog, 'gymaxis-issue-dialog')` line and re-test PATH A. If it now stays open on upload #2, the hook is at fault. Gate its popstate handler on `e.state?.['gymaxis-issue-dialog'] === undefined`.

Hypothesis 3: Radix DismissableLayer's `onFocusOutside` only fires for focus moving WITHIN the document. When the native file picker opens, focus leaves the document entirely → Radix may have an internal `onDismiss` path (not the public `onFocusOutside`) that fires regardless of preventDefault. Check @radix-ui/react-dialog version & source. May need to switch to a controlled <Dialog> with `modal={false}` or migrate the file input off Radix entirely.

Quick remediation that should fix BOTH PATH A and PATH B: move the file input OUTSIDE the <label> AND use a useRef + button onClick (`fileInputRef.current.click()`) instead of label-click delegation. This eliminates the label-click→input-click→pointerdown synthesis that's triggering Radix's dismiss.
critical_code_review_comments: FaultDialogs.js L371-379: — the label-wrap is the primary suspect now. Use ref-based imperative click instead.
FaultDialogs.js L53 onOpenChange has NO logging — please add a stack-trace console.log so the next test agent can see which call path is firing the close.
FaultDialogs.js L373 onChange: e.target.value='' is correct for re-selecting the same filename, but the setIssueMedia(prev=>...) is fine. The bug isn't here.
useBackGestureClose hook (lib/useBackGestureClose.js) — its popstate handler calls onResetDialog on ANY popstate while open. Worth bisecting by commenting out L48 to confirm/exclude as a cause.

rca_of_the_issue: Confirmed: the dialog unmount on 2nd file upload (PATH A) and on dropzone label-click (PATH B) is NOT caused by any of the four Radix outside-event hooks (onInteractOutside / onPointerDownOutside / onFocusOutside / onEscapeKeyDown — all four now preventDefault). The most plausible remaining cause is the <label>-wraps-<input type='file'> pattern combined with Radix DismissableLayer's internal focus/pointer-race that bypasses the public preventDefault props. Recommended fix: refactor the file input to a ref-based imperative click (input as sibling, button onClick=>ref.click()), eliminating the label-wrap. Secondary: instrument onOpenChange with a stack trace, and bisect useBackGestureClose by temporarily disabling it.
